description: Sub-Agent Orchestration Layer - Create a typed orchestrator that manages specialized sub-agents, detects technology/target types, dispatches agents (including parallel execution), manages lifecycle, and aggregates results. Inspired by Dark-Moon's agent-based pentest architecture.
steps: Create src/core/orchestrator/types.ts with interfaces: AgentConfig (name, description, capabilities: string[], triggers: string[], priority), AgentTask (id, type, target, params, createdAt), AgentResult (agentName, taskId, success, data, error, duration, findings: string[]), OrchestrationPlan (tasks: AgentTask[], selectedAgents: string[], parallel: boolean), AgentStatus (name, status: 'idle'|'running'|'error', lastRun, tasksCompleted, tasksFailed).

Create src/core/orchestrator/agent-runner.ts with class AgentRunner: abstract class similar to BaseStrategy pattern. Constructor takes logger + config (AgentConfig). Abstract method execute(task: AgentTask): Promise<AgentResult>. Concrete methods: canHandle(task) checks capabilities/triggers against task.type and task.target, getStatus() returns AgentStatus. Timeout protection via AbortController (30s default).

Create src/core/orchestrator/agent-registry.ts with class AgentRegistry: register(agent: AgentRunner), unregister(name), getAgent(name), listAgents() returns AgentConfig[], findAgentsForTask(task: AgentTask) filters by canHandle(), getAgentStatuses() returns all AgentStatus[].

Create src/core/orchestrator/orchestrator.ts with class SubAgentOrchestrator: constructor takes logger, registry (AgentRegistry). Methods: dispatch(task: AgentTask) selects agents via registry.findAgentsForTask then executes, dispatchParallel(tasks: AgentTask[]) runs multiple tasks concurrently with Promise.allSettled, planExecution(tasks) creates OrchestrationPlan detecting which agents to assign, aggregateResults(results: AgentResult[]) merges findings. Emits events for agent lifecycle (agent_started, agent_completed, agent_failed) via Node.js EventEmitter.

Create src/core/orchestrator/agents/security-agent.ts extending AgentRunner: handles security scan tasks, capabilities ['security-scan', 'vulnerability-check', 'contract-audit'], triggers on security-related task types.
Create src/core/orchestrator/agents/defi-agent.ts extending AgentRunner: handles DeFi tasks, capabilities ['token-analysis', 'liquidity-check', 'yield-farming', 'swap-routing'].
Create src/core/orchestrator/agents/bounty-agent.ts extending AgentRunner: handles bug bounty tasks, capabilities ['bounty-search', 'report-generation', 'scope-analysis'].
Create src/core/orchestrator/agents/market-agent.ts extending AgentRunner: handles market analysis, capabilities ['market-analysis', 'sentiment-analysis', 'price-tracking', 'trend-detection'].
Create src/core/orchestrator/agents/index.ts exporting all agent classes.
Create src/core/orchestrator/index.ts exporting SubAgentOrchestrator, AgentRegistry, AgentRunner, all types, and all agent implementations.

Create tests/core/orchestrator/orchestrator.test.ts: test dispatch (single agent), dispatchParallel (multiple agents concurrently), agent selection via canHandle, result aggregation, error handling for failed agents, timeout behavior.
Create tests/core/orchestrator/agent-registry.test.ts: test registration, listing, finding agents for tasks, unregistration.
Update src/core/index.ts to export SubAgentOrchestrator, AgentRegistry, AgentRunner, and orchestrator types from ./orchestrator/index.js
Update src/types/index.ts to re-export orchestrator types (AgentConfig, AgentTask, AgentResult, OrchestrationPlan, AgentStatus).
acceptance_criteria: AgentRegistry correctly registers agents and finds matching agents for tasks based on capabilities/triggers
SubAgentOrchestrator.dispatch() selects the right agent and returns AgentResult
SubAgentOrchestrator.dispatchParallel() runs agents concurrently and returns all results
AgentRunner timeout protection works (tasks exceeding 30s are aborted)
All four agent implementations are registered and can handle their respective task types
Running `npx tsc --noEmit` passes with no type errors
Running `npx vitest run tests/core/orchestrator/` passes all tests
findings: All 19 orchestrator tests pass. TypeScript compilation clean. Full implementation includes types, AgentRunner abstract class with timeout protection, AgentRegistry, SubAgentOrchestrator with EventEmitter, and 4 specialized agent implementations (security, defi, bounty, market). Exports added to src/core/index.ts and src/types/index.ts.
